WITH run_entries AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs
    FROM main.batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs AS runs
    FROM main.extra_runs
),
run_totals AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM run_entries
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
bowling AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler) AS bowler_count,
           COUNT(*) - COUNT(bowler) AS missing_bowlers
    FROM main.ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
overs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.bowler_count, b.missing_bowlers,
           COALESCE(r.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs
    FROM bowling AS b
    LEFT JOIN run_totals AS r USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC) AS run_rank,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, innings_no, over_id
           ) AS chronological_rank
    FROM overs
),
winning AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE run_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."match") AS matches_in_catalog,
    COUNT(DISTINCT winning.match_id) AS matches_with_overs,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."match" AS m
     WHERE m.match_id NOT IN (SELECT match_id FROM bowling)) AS matches_without_overs,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT winning.match_id) AS additional_tied_winners,
    SUM(bowler_count > 1) AS winning_overs_with_multiple_bowlers,
    SUM(bowler_count = 0) AS winning_overs_without_bowler,
    SUM(missing_bowlers > 0) AS winning_overs_with_null_bowler,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_totals AS r
     LEFT JOIN bowling AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
     WHERE b.match_id IS NULL) AS scoring_overs_without_bowling,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_entries WHERE runs IS NULL) AS null_run_entries,
    AVG(CASE WHEN chronological_rank = 1 THEN total_runs END) AS average_max_runs
FROM winning

WITH over_totals AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs,
           COUNT(DISTINCT b.bowler) AS bowler_count
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
    LEFT JOIN main.extra_runs AS e USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, innings_no, over_id
    ) AS over_rank
    FROM over_totals
)
SELECT
    sqlite_version() AS sqlite_version,
    COUNT(*) AS matches_with_deliveries,
    SUM(m.match_id IS NULL) AS delivery_matches_outside_catalog,
    GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN m.match_id IS NULL THEN r.match_id END) AS match_ids_outside_catalog,
    SUM(r.bowler_count > 1) AS selected_overs_with_multiple_bowlers,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.batsman_scored AS s
     LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
     WHERE b.match_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_batsman_entries,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.extra_runs AS e
     LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
     WHERE b.match_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_extra_entries,
    AVG(r.total_runs) AS overall_average,
    AVG(CASE WHEN m.match_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.total_runs END) AS catalog_average
FROM ranked AS r
LEFT JOIN main."match" AS m ON m.match_id = r.match_id
WHERE r.over_rank = 1

WITH run_entries AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs
    FROM main.batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs AS runs
    FROM main.extra_runs
),
over_totals AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM run_entries
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
over_bowlers AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id,
           JSON_GROUP_ARRAY(DISTINCT bowler ORDER BY bowler) AS bowler_ids
    FROM main.ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
ranked_overs AS (
    -- Include every match with recorded overs and take the earliest over among ties.
    SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.bowler_ids,
           COALESCE(t.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY b.match_id
               ORDER BY COALESCE(t.total_runs, 0) DESC, b.innings_no, b.over_id
           ) AS over_rank
    FROM over_bowlers AS b
    LEFT JOIN over_totals AS t USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
)
SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs, bowler_ids,
       AVG(total_runs) OVER () AS avg_highest_over_runs
FROM ranked_overs
WHERE over_rank = 1
ORDER BY match_id
